method: binormal AUROC model, Hanley-McNeil (1982) variance; one-sided alpha=0.05

formulas.power: power = Phi((A - T)/SE1), SE1 = sqrt(Var(A)) at the alternative
formulas.required_n: smallest integer n1 with power >= 0.80 (integer scan)
formulas.equal_variance_closed_form: n_per_group = 0.5*((z_(1-alpha)+z_power)/(A-0.5))^2 (1:1 ratio; cross-check for the manuscript's ~25)

hanley_mcneil_two_variance_1to1.note: integer scan with distinct null/alternative variances; more efficient because SE1 < SE0 at high A
